description.zh: 注册者所属国家或地区，2位的国家地区代码（参考GB/T 2659.1-2022）。
description.en: The country or region of the registrant. Specify a 2-character country or region code in compliance with GB/T 2659.1-2022.

description.zh: 注册者所在市。长度不超过255字符。所属国家是中国的，需符合GB/T 2260-2007要求。
description.en: The city of the registrant. The value cannot exceed 255 characters in length. If the country is China, the value must comply with GB/T 2260-2007.

description.zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样。
description.en:
Ensures the idempotency of the request. Generate a unique parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The ClientToken value supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may vary for each API request.

description.zh: 注册者证件号码。长度不超过50字符。
description.en: The document number of the registrant. The value cannot exceed 50 characters in length.

description.zh: 注册者证件图片(base64)。原文件大小为50KB-3MB。
description.en: The document image of the registrant in Base64 encoding. The original file size must be between 50 KB and 3 MB.

description.zh: 电子邮箱。长度不超过300字符。
description.en: The email address. The value cannot exceed 300 characters in length.

description.zh: 注册者名称。长度不超过255字符。
description.en: The name of the registrant. The value cannot exceed 255 characters in length.

description.zh: 注册者联系电话。长度不超过128字符。所属国家是中国的，非手机号码区号需与所在市匹配。
description.en: The phone number of the registrant. The value cannot exceed 128 characters in length. If the country is China and the number is not a mobile phone number, the area code must match the city.

description.zh: 注册者所在省。长度不超过255字符。所属国家是中国的，需符合GB/T 2260-2007要求。
description.en: The province of the registrant. The value cannot exceed 255 characters in length. If the country is China, the value must comply with GB/T 2260-2007.

description.zh: 注册者地址。长度不超过255字符。
description.en: The address of the registrant. The value cannot exceed 255 characters in length.
